name: HotKey Internet
summary: Melbourne SMB ISP founded 1996; Primus acquired 60% March 1998, remaining 40% January 1999, but the HotKey brand continued as a Primus subsidiary (18 franchises) acquiring more ISPs through 2004 (HOTKEY INTERNET SERVICES PTY LTD, ACN 075 759 821).

events.details: Brand wound down after last acquisitions (still a Primus subsidiary). HotKey kept selling broadband/dialup until its site was blanked between early 2019 and 25 Aug 2019, exactly matching the c. 2019 proposal. full retail ISP site into early 2019; homepage blanked by Aug 2019.

refs.label: Jan 2016 (and again through 2018/early 2019): full retail broadband ISP site, refuting the current c. 2004.
By 25 Aug 2019 the homepage is an entirely blank HTML shell; CDX then shows only sporadic 302s - the brand had been wound down under Primus/M2/Vocus.
ABR: HOTKEY INTERNET SERVICES PTY LTD ACN 075 759 821
